d: Long, wavy burnt-orange hair with thick bangs and a side-swept parting is adorned with a black-and-white checkered headband. The eyes are a pale greyish-gold with a stoic, focused expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build is dressed in a white high-collared tunic with a flared skirt, paired with a grey short capelet, white leggings, and grey lace-up shoes, all accented by gold buttons and a black-and-white checkered bag. Signature details include white gloves, gold earrings, and a small, pointed crystal wand held in the hand.
